# Search field (`search-field`)

Search box with clear button and keyboard-driven suggestions.

Group: Text inputs. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/text-inputs';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createSearchField` (types in `dist/web/text-inputs/searchField.d.ts`): `.mh-input.mh-search`: a search input with a leading search icon and a clear button that shows while there is text. Escape clears (and only bubbles when already empty); Enter calls `onSearch`.

```ts
export function createSearchField(options: SearchFieldOptions = {}): SearchFieldHandle;

export interface SearchFieldOptions {
  /** Accessible name of the input (default "Search"). */
  label?: string;
  value?: string;
  placeholder?: string;
  name?: string;
  size?: InputSize;
  disabled?: boolean;
  /** Accessible name of the clear button (default "Clear search"). */
  clearLabel?: string;
  /** Marks the box as a search landmark (`role="search"`); use for a page's main search only. */
  landmark?: boolean;
  onInput?: (value: string, event: Event) => void;
  /** Enter pressed. */
  onSearch?: (value: string) => void;
  /** The clear button or Escape emptied the field. */
  onClear?: () => void;
}

export interface SearchFieldHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  input: HTMLInputElement;
  clearButton: HTMLButtonElement;
  getValue(): string;
  setValue(value: string): void;
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createSearchField } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const rooms = ['Living room', 'Kitchen', 'Bedroom', 'Study', 'Hallway'];
const results = document.createElement('ul');

function show(query: string) {
  const q = query.trim().toLowerCase();
  const matches = rooms.filter((room) => room.toLowerCase().includes(q));
  results.replaceChildren(...matches.map((room) => Object.assign(document.createElement('li'), { textContent: room })));
}

const search = createSearchField({
  placeholder: 'Search rooms',
  onInput: (value) => show(value),
  onClear: () => show(''),
});
show('');

document.body.append(search.el, results);
```

## React API

`SearchField` (types in `dist/react/text-inputs.d.ts`): Same DOM and classes as `createSearchField`. Clearing calls `onValueChange('')` and `onClear`.

```ts
export function SearchField({ label = 'Search', value, defaultValue, size, clearLabel = 'Clear search', landmark, onValueChange, onSearch, onClear, onChange, onKeyDown, disabled, className, ...rest }: SearchFieldProps);

export interface SearchFieldProps extends Omit<InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement>, 'size' | 'type' | 'value' | 'defaultValue'> {
  /** Accessible name (default "Search"). */
  label?: string;
  value?: string;
  defaultValue?: string;
  size?: InputSize;
  clearLabel?: string;
  /** `role="search"` on the box; for a page's main search only. */
  landmark?: boolean;
  /** Called with the new text on every change, including the clear button and Escape. */
  onValueChange?: (value: string) => void;
  onSearch?: (value: string) => void;
  onClear?: () => void;
}
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { SearchField } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

const rooms = ['Living room', 'Kitchen', 'Bedroom', 'Study', 'Hallway'];

export function SearchFieldExample() {
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('');
  const matches = rooms.filter((room) => room.toLowerCase().includes(query.trim().toLowerCase()));
  return (
    <>
      <SearchField placeholder="Search rooms" value={query} onValueChange={setQuery} />
      <ul>
        {matches.map((room) => (
          <li key={room}>{room}</li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </>
  );
}
```
